purpose: Deterministic engineering fixtures; not AI-performance measurements.

tasks.title: Validate batch records before storage
tasks.requirement: Each input row is a dictionary. Save records with a non-empty string identifier exactly once, skip absent, empty or whitespace identifiers, and continue after these invalid dictionaries. Handling non-dictionary rows is out of scope.
tasks.decision: Keep validation before the storage callback. Counting successful saves is a separate dependent task.
criteria: R1: A valid record is saved once.
R2: Missing, empty and whitespace identifiers never reach storage.
R3: Mixed input continues to later valid records.

tasks.title: Validate pagination arguments
tasks.requirement: Return zero-based pages; reject negative indexes and non-positive sizes, booleans or non-integers; return an empty list beyond the end. Do not change application settings.
tasks.decision: Raise ValueError consistently instead of silently clamping invalid inputs.
criteria: R1: Ordinary zero-based pagination returns the requested items.
R2: Invalid argument types or ranges raise ValueError.
R3: Empty or out-of-range requests return an empty list.

baseline.pagination.py:
def page(items, index, size):
    return items[index * size:(index + 1) * size]

tasks.title: Make JSON export deterministic and strict
tasks.requirement: Sort keys, use compact separators, preserve Unicode, and reject non-finite numeric values.
tasks.decision: Use the standard JSON encoder and reject non-standard numbers instead of coercing them.
criteria: R1: Output has sorted keys and compact separators.
R3: NaN and infinity raise ValueError.
